email.subject: Re: NOYA Concierge × YKONE | Egypt & Beyond
paragraphs: Following our call on 8 October, I have put our conversation into a short Egypt brief for YKONE. It is attached.

It sets out how we would work together: YKONE leads the creative vision and the brand relationship, and NOYA handles everything on the ground in Egypt, under your name. It includes one idea to start, a private brand dinner at the Pyramids or the Grand Egyptian Museum, and a single page for your next brief that points to Egypt.
If anything is live this quarter or next, share whatever is known and we will come back with a concept and a costed proposal.
